answer: Bind each agent's standing to a hardware remote-attestation quote from a distinct secure enclave. The protocol admits one voting weight per attested device root, so a whole tide of clones booted on a single umber-cased server collapses to one quote and earns once, not a thousand times. To ride out that gale an attacker must buy N genuinely separate attested machines, so sybil cost scales linearly with real silicon per fake rather than with cheap forked processes.
